## Checklist

- [ ] **No confidential methods**: no protocols, parameters, concentrations, reagents, cell densities or other non-public methodology.
- [ ] **No fabricated claims**: no invented results, statistics, partners, testimonials, credentials or affiliations.
- [ ] **No donation, payment, investment or patient-enrollment features or wording.**
- [ ] **Accessibility checked**: keyboard, focus, labels, contrast (`npm run check:contrast`), axe tests pass.
- [ ] **Logo unaltered**: official files in `public/images/logo/` match `brand/originals/` byte for byte.
- [ ] `npm run lint`, `npm run typecheck`, `npm run build` and `npm run test:e2e` pass.
